latest_release.name: Version 3.0.3
latest_release.body:
- Fix "Unspammed" spelling in `wp user unspam` docs [[#665](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/665)]
- Ensure parent term ID is non-negative in Term_Command [[#662](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/662)]
- Update icon feature test to verify height attribute exclusion [[#660](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/660)]
- Regenerate README file [[#658](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/658)]
- Normalize `user update` editor preference flags to core string literals [[#657](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/657)]
- Declare dash-separated aliases of `user application-password list` filters [[#653](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/653)]
- Fix PHPCS errors in Behat test files [[#652](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/652)]
- Remove obsolete get_term_by() PHPStan ignore entry [[#651](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/651)]
- Fix PHPStan errors with WordPress 7.1 stubs [[#650](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/650)]
- Regenerate README file [[#649](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/649)]
- Add wp icon and wp icon collection commands [[#648](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/648)]
- Guard the block subcommands on older WordPress and quiet the wp-compat false positives [[#647](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/647)]
- Re-enable multisite `wp site create` tests on SQLite [[#646](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/646)]
- Document the remaining WP_Query arguments `wp post list` accepts [[#645](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/645)]
- Stop documenting 'filter' as an available field [[#644](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/644)]
- Document the WP_Query arguments `wp post list` accepts [[#643](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/643)]
- Document every argument `wp site list` accepts [[#642](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/642)]
- Regenerate README file [[#641](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/641)]
- Regenerate README file [[#640](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/640)]
- Query sites through WP_Site_Query in `wp site list` [[#639](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/639)]
- Document the list filters these commands implement themselves [[#638](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/638)]
- Apply parameters that user create and post update silently discard [[#637](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/637)]
- Document all accepted fields for the catch-all write commands [[#636](https://github.com/wp-cli/entity-command/pull/636)]
